measures.share_development_areas: Share of municipal land in development areas
measures.pending_share: Share of planned dwellings not materialised
measures.unstarted_share: Share of development land not yet started

notes.land_shares: Percentages of municipal area. Sum to 100 excluding share_development_areas, which overlaps urban_nonconsolidated + urbanizable_delimited.
notes.mun_area_km2: SIU MunTotSue, municipal area in km2 (checked against known municipal areas).
notes.pending_share: pending_dwellings / planned_dwellings. A stock of plan capacity, not a delay measure.
notes.rents: INE Urban Indicators table 69330, annual rent in EUR/m2.
notes.serpavi: MIVAU SERPAVI 2011-2024, Municipios sheet, 2024 median monthly rent per m2 of collective residential buildings. Tax-source statistic (Modelo 100), independent of INE 69330; excludes Navarra and the Basque Country.

validation.note: MIVAU national aggregate, 5,900 reporting municipalities. Used to check that the 431-municipality sample is a large subset and not a different universe. The sample is not a random draw.

validation.definition: ALQM2_LV_M_VC_24: median monthly rent per m2 of collective residential buildings, Modelo 100 tax records
validation.note: SERPAVI is built from tax declarations (Modelo 100) and is independent of INE table 69330. It excludes Navarra and the Basque Country because those foral regimes do not report to the common tax source. Agreement in levels does not make the two series the same measurement: SERPAVI is a median of monthly rent per m2, INE is a mean annual rent per m2.

plan_vintage.note: Newer plans have a higher pending share. This is consistent with capacity that has not had time to be built, and is a direct reason not to read the pending stock as obstruction.
